title: Surfaces with canonical map of odd degree
summary: Let $S$ be a smooth complex minimal surface of general type with $p_g:=h^0(K_S)\ge 4$ whose canonical map is generically finite of odd degree $d>1$ onto a surface $Σ$. We assume that the general canonical curve of $S$ is smooth and that $Σ$ is ruled by lines, and we prove: - $p_g\le d+2$ - $Σ$ is a cone over the rational normal curve of degree $p_g-2$ in ${\mathbb P}^{p_g-1}$ - $p_g=d+2$ can occur only for $d=3,9,11$.
